title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 32: Science and technology (Set 2)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Science and technology (Set 2) ngay nhé!

(Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập.)

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Science and technology (Set 2)
vocabTable.example: Complete the text, using the words given. You may make any changes to the words if necessary. There are 2 words or phrases that you do not need to use. invent increase robot teacher motivate nano learning cheating Technology is changing how people learn and work. In some schools, they use 15.1 to give lessons and answer students’ questions in online classes. This makes learning more interactive and interesting. Another modern method is 15.2 , which teaches small topics in short lessons. It allows students to learn step by step and remember information more easily. Smart devices also 15.3 convenience because they let people study, work, and shop from different places. Many daily tasks become easier with these tools. Some apps and websites give rewards to 15.4 users. When people receive points or badges, they feel encouraged to complete tasks. This makes both learning and working more enjoyable. In the future, new technology will appear and continue bringing more useful solutions. As a result, life will become faster, smarter, and more efficient for everyone.
